column1: # GB deduplication report: one row per record with a sequence (kept / dropped); records without ORIGIN
# and parse errors are counted in the total line only. Rules: (1) same accession -> newest version;
# (2) RefSeq NC_ record kept, the INSDC submission it was derived from (named in its COMMENT) dropped;
# (3) identical sequence -> one copy kept (RefSeq preferred). Different records of the same species
# are NOT merged. related = accession kept instead (dropped) / accessions it replaced (kept).
